conditions.detail: Box dedicated to this run. The qwen-image-spark server on :8020 is the lane under test and the only process holding the GPU; no second engine, no compile, no desktop session. Ambient temperature unknown (no sensor on this box).
conditions.isolation_check: nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps listed exactly one pid (the :8020 uvicorn worker) before and during the run; pgrep found no sglang, vllm, comfy or sd-cli process. A 1 Hz sampler recorded the sum of --query-compute-apps and free -m for the whole run.

gotchas.text: The driver reported thermal/hardware slowdown during the run — the numbers are throttled.

nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used returns [N/A] on GB10: the CPU and the GPU share one pool and the per-device counter is not implemented. vram_peak_gb here comes from the sum of --query-compute-apps=used_memory instead, which the harness now falls back to. It is a whole-device figure and it is only equal to this lane's footprint because the box ran nothing else.

The model name on the wire is not the Hugging Face repo id. This server's build_job lowercases the model field and checks it against {"", "qwen-image-2.1", "qwen-image", "qwen", "gpt-image-1", "dall-e-3", "dall-e-2"}, so a packet that sends Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1 gets a 400 on every request. The packet carries served_model_id=qwen-image-2.1.

Effective guidance was 1.0, the lane's own default: guidance_scale is a per-request field, not a QIMG_ variable, and build_job falls back to 1.0 when neither guidance_scale nor true_cfg_scale is sent. The workloads send neither, so args carries no guidance and the number to compare against another lane is 1.0. Above 1.0 this pipeline runs a second transformer forward per step, which roughly doubles seconds per image.

Seconds per image are the server's own timing.total_ms (queue/encode/denoise/decode), not the HTTP wall clock; the harness prefers it for this engine. On the smoke render the two were 53.432 s and 53.45 s, so the client costs ~20 ms.

QIMG_MAX_PIXELS defaults to 4300800 in 0.1.1 (it was 4227072 in 0.1.0). Every shape these suites ask for fits: 2048x2048 is 4194304 and 2752x1536 is 4227072. On 0.1.0 the 2752x1536 adherence and fidelity cases would have been refused with a 400.

This lane renders 1024x1024 at 40 steps within a 0.21 s band over 17 independent cases (52.83-53.04 s), so its percentiles are narrow by construction and a p90/p50 gap here means a shape change, not variance. 2048x2048 costs 251.5 s, 4.75x the 1K time for 4x the pixels; one reference image adds ~6 s and a second ~8 s more.

provenance.notes: NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10, sm_121), driver 580.173.02, CUDA 13.0, aarch64 Ubuntu 24.04, 121 GiB unified memory. qwen-image-21-spark 0.1.1 serving the diffusers QwenImage21Pipeline in bf16 behind FastAPI on :8020, one image at a time under a lock, torch 2.14.0+cu130, diffusers main @80c7ed262aeffbeb43ef13ae04baeb9b84515a69, transformers 5.17.0, attention sdpa, QIMG_MAX_PIXELS 4300800. This is the bf16 reference lane: the fidelity suite here is scored against a reference bundle rendered by this same configuration, so it is a determinism check rather than a quality one. Ambient temperature unknown.
